long_biography.plain_text:
Before building his drinks business, Yuri Schefler helped establish Moscow's Sadko-Arkada shopping complex and chaired Vnukovo Airlines. His move into spirits followed an introduction to Vladimir Yamnikov, then head of the Kristall distillery. Yamnikov wanted to build a company capable of competing internationally with its own brands.

That ambition required more than buying a distillery. Schefler assembled commercial rights held by different distributors. SPI purchased rights in markets including Spain, Chile and China and bought the American rights from PepsiCo. He paired this work with production and distribution infrastructure. The acquisition of Latvia's Latvijas Balzams added an established regional business, extending the group's manufacturing base beyond Russia.
